notes.title: Level changes, bug fixes and new unlocks
notes.notes:
A minor update that fixes some issues from the last version. The levels have been rebalanced, there is a new level, and now color pallets are unlocked when finishing levels.

[h1]Major Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Color Pallet unlocks
[/list]

[h1]Minor Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Removed Level 3
[*] Level 2 is now a rebalanced level 3
[*] A new Level 2!
[*] Added the main menu button to the game screen
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed initial resources that sometimes were different when the level restarted
[*] Fixed the configuration color pallet not showing the current pallet
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.7.0
notes.notes:
As we are getting closer to launch on the first quarter of next year, we have added lots of new things to the game. The biggest change is new the user interface elements with sounds and animations.

[h2]Major changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed secondary objectives
[*] New User Interface
[*] Building color pallets
[*] Added tractor beam particle effect
[*] New level selection screen
[*] New rewards screen
[/list]
[h2]Minor changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Locked levels in level selector
[*] Added checkbox to level objectives
[*] Added reward card animation and SFX
[*] Upgraded Completed/Failed panel UI
[*] Upgraded tooltips UI
[*] Upgraded building sidebar UI
[*] Upgraded resources view UI
[*] Removed global timer in UI
[*] Adjusted asteroid SFX volume
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed pause menu to only open during the game
[*] Fixed dialogue panel flickering
[*] Fixed tooltip hiding
[/list]
